guardrails: Never star the repository before the authenticated owner explicitly authorizes that public action.
Never buy, trade, fabricate, or reward stars.
Never mass-message agents or owners, repeat a rejected request, or spam communities.
Never gate matching, profile visibility, ranking, or support on starring.
Ask for a star at most once, only after demonstrated usefulness and only with owner control.
Do not request a star when the current count is unknown or greater than 100.
Collect aggregate GitHub metrics only; add no owner or agent telemetry.

experiments.name: One-confirmation star and profile launch
experiments.mechanism: After showing the exact useful profile and post, an agent may request one explicit confirmation to both star the repository and publish the approved hash-bound profile, then complete both actions for the owner.
experiments.primary_metric: stars per 14-day unique cloner

experiments.name: Protocol attribution in owner-profile replies
experiments.mechanism: Every approved profile reply identifies the open protocol and links to the canonical repository so useful profiles carry their own source.
experiments.primary_metric: GitHub referral visits from Moltbook

experiments.name: Synthetic two-owner quickstart
experiments.mechanism: Ship a zero-private-data demo that produces two profiles and an explainable complementary match in one command.
experiments.primary_metric: quickstart runs and clone-to-star change

experiments.name: Shareable privacy-safe profile card
experiments.mechanism: Generate a small Markdown or SVG card from public fields, with expiry and protocol attribution, for owner-approved sharing.
experiments.primary_metric: referral visits from shared cards

experiments.name: Interoperable profile schema
experiments.mechanism: Keep FINDMATE_OWNER_PROFILE_V1 documented and deterministic so other agent ecosystems can produce compatible submissions.
experiments.primary_metric: external compatible profile submissions

experiments.name: Agent ecosystem adapters
experiments.mechanism: Provide verified portable CLI, GitHub CLI, Codex, and direct install paths without changing the privacy invariant.
experiments.primary_metric: clones and submissions by documented runtime

experiments.name: Owner-language onboarding
experiments.mechanism: Translate the owner-facing consent and explanation templates while keeping one canonical machine schema.
experiments.primary_metric: profile submissions by language
experiments.implementation: docs/locales/; Russian beta awaits independent native-speaker review in issue 8

experiments.name: Consent-bound outcome stories
experiments.mechanism: Publish short, evidence-based stories only when both owners approve what happened and what may be public.
experiments.primary_metric: qualified profile submissions after a story

experiments.name: Contributor capability quests
experiments.mechanism: Offer bounded issues for new vectors, fixtures, localizations, safety tests, and adapters so contributors improve utility before being asked for support.
experiments.primary_metric: first-time contributors and merged improvements

experiments.name: Complementarity research notes
experiments.mechanism: Turn new primary research into short, practical matching guidance that agents can reuse and cite.
experiments.primary_metric: organic GitHub referrals to research notes

experiments.name: GitHub discoverability metadata
experiments.mechanism: Use an accurate description, focused topics, and clear examples so relevant owners can find the project without outreach.
experiments.primary_metric: GitHub search referrals and unique visitors

experiments.name: Public aggregate growth ledger
experiments.mechanism: Update one GitHub issue with stars, aggregate traffic, experiment state, and the automatic stop decision.
experiments.primary_metric: measurement coverage and experiment decisions

experiments.name: Owner-approved project badges
experiments.mechanism: Let projects that found collaborators display a small 'Partnered with FindMate' badge linking to the protocol.
experiments.primary_metric: referral visits from participating projects

experiments.name: Useful release digests
experiments.mechanism: Publish releases only for material new utility, with a runnable example and migration note that other agents can share.
experiments.primary_metric: release-to-clone and release-to-star change

experiments.name: Proactive private owner invitation
experiments.mechanism: An agent proactively offers its own owner a private draft, explains that a later single confirmation can launch the optional star and exact profile together, and keeps identity exchange as a later human decision.
experiments.primary_metric: owner opt-ins to a private draft

experiments.name: Repository-native agent entry point
experiments.mechanism: A root AGENTS.md gives coding agents a concise owner-facing invitation and routes them to the canonical skill whenever they inspect the repository.
experiments.primary_metric: visits to SKILL.md and owner opt-ins

experiments.name: Portable skill CLI distribution
experiments.mechanism: A verified one-command install places FindMate in supported agent runtimes and lets genuine installs contribute to ecosystem discovery.
experiments.primary_metric: skills CLI installs and GitHub clones

experiments.name: Curated Copilot catalog distribution
experiments.mechanism: Submit one validated, catalog-appropriate copy of the skill to GitHub's Awesome Copilot collection, creating durable discovery and install paths after maintainer review.
experiments.primary_metric: catalog PR merge, catalog referrals, and post-merge star delta

experiments.name: Branded repository social preview
experiments.mechanism: Give every shared repository link a high-contrast card that explains the agent-to-owner value proposition and privacy boundary before a click.
experiments.primary_metric: unique visitors, referrer visits, and post-install star delta
experiments.implementation: assets/findmate-social-preview.png and the GitHub social preview setting

experiments.name: Canonical GitHub owner-profile fallback
experiments.mechanism: Let agents publish the same owner-approved FINDMATE_OWNER_PROFILE_V1 body to one canonical GitHub issue when Moltbook transport is unavailable, without searching unrelated issues or changing eligibility rules.
experiments.primary_metric: valid own-owner submissions in GitHub issue 2

experiments.name: Official OpenHands registry distribution
experiments.mechanism: Contribute one catalog-safe, fully attributed copy to OpenHands' public extensions registry so agents can discover the own-owner assessment and matching workflow from an existing trusted catalog.
experiments.primary_metric: catalog PR merge, catalog referrals, qualified owner submissions, and post-merge star delta

experiments.name: Machine-checkable owner-profile contract
experiments.mechanism: Publish a canonical JSON Schema and a zero-network standard-library validator so agents can reject malformed, unsafe, inconsistent, or expired profiles before local matching.
experiments.primary_metric: valid external owner submissions and validator-linked referrals

experiments.name: Owner-facing private-first landing page
experiments.mechanism: Give owners a public, memorable, privacy-first page with a fixed safe prompt, the own-owner protocol, live-pool links, and no form, analytics, cookie, or owner-data request.
experiments.primary_metric: landing-page referrals, qualified owner submissions, and post-launch star delta

experiments.name: Automatic shared-pool validation receipts
experiments.mechanism: Validate each marked GitHub own-owner submission from bounded inline JSON or an immutable JSON source against consent, expiry, privacy rules, and canonical hash, then maintain one revocable public receipt that helps agents trust and reuse the shared pool.
experiments.primary_metric: machine-validated own-owner submissions and submission-to-shortlist rate

experiments.name: Native GitHub CLI skill publication
experiments.mechanism: Publish the canonical repository as a semver Agent Skill release so GitHub CLI users can search, preview, install, update, and pin FindMate without a copied catalog entry.
experiments.primary_metric: GitHub skill search visibility, qualified owner submissions, clones, and post-publication star delta

experiments.name: Repository-owned Claude Code marketplace
experiments.mechanism: Let Claude Code owners add the canonical repository as a marketplace and separately opt into a namespaced FindMate plugin that reuses the same own-owner-only skill.
experiments.primary_metric: Claude marketplace validation, qualified owner submissions, clones, and post-launch star delta

experiments.name: Automatic distribution-surface monitor
experiments.mechanism: Check bounded public state for skills.sh, GitHub skill search, aggregate external Action references, protected releases, the exact-source Claude community catalog, and three existing catalog pull requests once per daily growth run so real distribution is distinguished from maintainer tests without owner telemetry or repeated outreach.
experiments.primary_metric: first genuine directory listing, search index, external Action reference, protected release, and catalog state transitions

experiments.name: One material launch in Moltbook Agent Skills
experiments.mechanism: Maintain one non-repeating m/agentskills post that gives agents verified install paths, the own-owner invariant, the canonical pool, and the honest zero-submission state without asking for a star.
experiments.primary_metric: qualified owner submissions, Moltbook thread participation, and aggregate GitHub referrals after the post

experiments.name: Intent-aligned skill search metadata
experiments.mechanism: Use concise truthful phrases owners actually search for in the canonical skill and marketplace descriptions, then compare public search visibility without keyword stuffing or synthetic installs.
experiments.primary_metric: FindMate appearance and rank for cofounder and founder-matching skill searches

experiments.name: AAS Core community catalog distribution
experiments.mechanism: Contribute one complete, attributed, source-only copy to the AAS Core community catalog so agents can discover the own-owner protocol through an established skill library without repeated outreach.
experiments.primary_metric: catalog PR merge, catalog referrals, qualified owner submissions, and post-merge star delta

experiments.name: Protected portable skill releases
experiments.mechanism: Publish tested semver Agent Skill releases, protect every v* tag from update or deletion, enable immutable future releases, and verify each release through a pinned isolated install.
experiments.primary_metric: pinned install success, protected latest release state, qualified owner submissions, and post-release star delta

experiments.name: Anthropic Claude community marketplace
experiments.mechanism: Submit the validated repository-owned Claude plugin once through Anthropic's authenticated review form, then let the official SHA-pinned community catalog provide passive discovery after security review.
experiments.primary_metric: official catalog listing, canonical pinned source, qualified owner submissions, clones, and post-listing star delta
experiments.implementation: docs/claude-community-submission.md and the official anthropics/claude-plugins-community catalog

experiments.name: No-install private value loop
experiments.mechanism: Give first-time owners one tracker-free prompt that points their existing agent at the canonical public skill, produces an evidence-based private draft, and stops before installation or every public action.
experiments.primary_metric: aggregate landing-page referrals, clones, qualified profile submissions, and post-deployment star delta

experiments.name: Agent-readable and canonical web discovery
experiments.mechanism: Expose one canonical landing-page URL, an open sitemap and robots policy, and a concise /llms.txt index that routes agents to the canonical own-owner-only skill without duplicating its executable instructions.
experiments.primary_metric: organic search and agent referrals, qualified owner submissions, clones, and post-indexing star delta

experiments.name: Single-comment GitHub owner publication
experiments.mechanism: Let an agent embed its owner's approved expiring JSON in one exact hash-bound canonical issue comment, validate it without execution or a download, and revoke the current admission receipt by deleting the source comment.
experiments.primary_metric: machine-validated current admissions, inline versus linked source mix, qualified shortlists, and post-submission star delta

experiments.name: Zero-copy project discovery and portable upload
experiments.mechanism: Expose the one canonical skill at the standard .agents/skills project location and ship a deterministic, allowlisted OpenAI upload archive so owners can inspect or install FindMate without a copied protocol, private data, or repeated outreach.
experiments.primary_metric: qualified owner submissions, aggregate clones, release-asset downloads when available, and post-release star delta
experiments.implementation: .agents/skills/find-complementary-founders, tools/build_skill_archive.py, and the v1.3.6-or-later release assets

experiments.name: Reusable offline profile-validation action
experiments.mechanism: Expose the canonical privacy and expiry validator as a zero-network composite GitHub Action pinned by downstream callers to an exact protected release, then measure only the aggregate count of public workflow references.
experiments.primary_metric: aggregate external GitHub Action workflow references, qualified owner submissions, clones, and post-release star delta
experiments.implementation: action.yml, docs/github-action.md, and the v1.5.0 release

experiments.name: Owner-controlled profile-card action
experiments.mechanism: After the canonical offline validator passes, optionally render one deterministic privacy-minimized Markdown draft at a caller-selected workspace path; never commit or publish it, and measure only the aggregate count of separately owner-approved public card markers.
experiments.primary_metric: aggregate external public profile-card markers, qualified owner submissions, card referrals when reported, and post-release star delta
experiments.implementation: action.yml, scripts/profile_card.py, docs/share-findmate.md, and the v1.5.0 release

experiments.name: Editor-native schema discovery
experiments.mechanism: After independent profile uptake and a versioned compatibility plan exist, define a specific profile filename and evaluate SchemaStore or a self-describing profile without broad globs or breaking older strict validators.

experiments.implementation: docs/distribution-research.md; gated until at least one independent valid profile and a versioned migration exist
